title: Welcome to VIT Vellore
subtitle: Four Decades of Excellence (1984–Present)
desc: Step into the virtual museum of Vellore Institute of Technology. Established in 1984, VIT has grown from an initial 180 students into India's premier Institution of Eminence hosting over 40,000 scholars.
waypointNotes: Grand Entrance Lobby facing the official welcome feature wall and reception directory.

title: The Beginning & 1984 Foundation
subtitle: Genesis of Vellore Engineering College (VEC)
desc: Founded in 1984 as a self-financing collegiate institution in Tamil Nadu with just 180 students across Mechanical, Electrical, and Civil disciplines.
waypointNotes: West Wing timeline entry point near 1984 archival photo display.

title: Founder & Chancellor Dr. G. Viswanathan
subtitle: Visionary Statesman & Educational Pioneer
desc: Former Parliamentarian and Tamil Nadu Minister whose visionary leadership steered VIT to global academic stature with the motto 'A Place to Learn, A Chance to Grow'.
waypointNotes: Honoring the founder's life, honorary doctorates, and educational reforms.

title: Four Decades of Institutional Evolution
subtitle: Deemed University, ABET Benchmark & Institution of Eminence
desc: Trace university milestones: Deemed University status in 2001, iconic Technology Tower construction in 2008, pioneering ABET accreditations in 2010, and IoE recognition in 2019.
waypointNotes: Panoramic view of the historical milestone wall panels.

title: Academic Schools & Multidisciplinary Wings
subtitle: SCOPE, SENSE, SELECT, SMEC, Sciences & Management
desc: 15+ multidisciplinary schools offering advanced STEM curricula, state-of-the-art computational laboratories, and world-class faculty mentoring over 60 degree programs.

title: Curricular Innovation: FFCS
subtitle: Fully Flexible Credit System & Student Agency
desc: First in India to offer true academic flexibility, enabling scholars to choose their professors, course timings, interdisciplinary minors, and semester-abroad credits.
waypointNotes: Pedagogical innovations display and Central Library features.

title: Campus Miniature Model & Masterplan
subtitle: 372-Acre Vellore Smart Campus
desc: Miniature 3D architectural representation of iconic landmarks: Technology Tower, Silver Jubilee Tower, Main Admin Block, and Anna Auditorium.
waypointNotes: Center atrium display table with glass protective enclosure.

title: Central VIT Monument & Iconic Gateway
subtitle: Official Insignia, Heritage Motto & Architectural Landmark
desc: Grand rectangular monolith featuring the official university emblem, 3D relief lettering, and photographic tribute to the iconic VIT Vellore Main Entrance Arch.
waypointNotes: Atrium central landmark orienting visitors between wings.

title: Grand Staircase & Transition to Floor 2
subtitle: Ascend to Research, Achievements & Campus Life
desc: Take the grand architectural staircase or use the accessible elevator to reach Floor 2: Innovation, Impact & Student Life.
waypointNotes: South-East transition core connecting the two museum levels.

title: Research & Innovation Ecosystem
subtitle: 50,000+ Scopus Papers, Top Patent Filings & Grants
desc: Ranked 14th in India for Research (NIRF 2025), VIT is a powerhouse of sponsored research with grants from DST, ISRO, DRDO, and global industrial leaders.
waypointNotes: Floor 2 West Gallery Research Wing entry point.

title: Research Centres & Interactive Table
subtitle: Nanotechnology, Clean Energy, Biomedical & VITTBI
desc: Explore specialized research centres (CNR, CBCMT, ARC) and the VITTBI Technology Business Incubator which has incubated 150+ tech startups.
waypointNotes: Interactive digital table in Floor 2 West Gallery.

title: Wall of Achievements & Recognition
subtitle: NIRF Top 15, NAAC A++ (3.66/4) & Global Honors
desc: Celebrating institutional excellence: NAAC A++ Grade accreditation, NIRF top tier rankings, QS World Rankings, and Smart India Hackathon consecutive championships.
waypointNotes: Floor 2 North Wall of Fame with trophy pedestals and medallions.

title: VIT Around the World — Global Connections
subtitle: 300+ Partner Universities & Semester Abroad Program
desc: Interactive world collaboration map showcasing international dual-degrees, Semester Abroad Programs, and a vibrant community of scholars from 50+ nations.
waypointNotes: Floor 2 South Gallery central wall facing atrium.

title: Life at VIT — Riviera & Cultural Vibrance
subtitle: ISO 9001:2015 Certified International Cultural Carnival
desc: Riviera hosts 30,000+ participants across 100+ events. Experience the energy of cultural concerts, dramatic arts, outdoor marathons, and diverse student life.
waypointNotes: Floor 2 East Gallery student life photo gallery wall.

title: Technical Culture — graVITas & Racing Teams
subtitle: Hackathons, IEEE/ACM Chapters & Formula Student
desc: graVITas annual techno-management festival, 120+ active student clubs and international chapters, plus student-built formula race cars competing globally.
waypointNotes: Floor 2 East Gallery technical events and student chapters display.

title: VIT Today & The Future — The Journey Continues
subtitle: Over 200,000 Global Alumni & Vision 2030
desc: Tour finale celebrating 40 years of transformative education and looking forward to sustainable, carbon-neutral, and AI-driven innovations for Vision 2030.
waypointNotes: Grand Tour Finale Installation overlooking the central atrium.
